text: 南向资金今日大幅净买入58.46亿元。港股通（沪）方面，阿里巴巴-W、智谱分别获净买入21.21亿港元、5.16亿港元；华虹宏力净卖出额居首，金额为0.1亿港元；港股通（深）方面，智谱、建滔积层板分别获净买入3.27亿港元、1.11亿港元；阿里巴巴-W净卖出额居首，金额为9.97亿港元。
text_en: Southbound funds recorded a large net purchase of 5.846 billion yuan today. On the Stock Connect (Shanghai) side, Alibaba-W and Zhipu received net purchases of HK$2.121 billion and HK$516 million respectively; Hua Hong Semiconductor saw the largest net sale, at HK$10 million; on the Stock Connect (Shenzhen) side, Zhipu and Kingboard Laminates received net purchases of HK$327 million and HK$111 million respectively; Alibaba-W saw the largest net sale, at HK$997 million.
